high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals walking on a sidewalk next to a white van. The person in the foreground is wearing a light-colored, floral-patterned dress with a scalloped hemline. The dress features a crop top and a flowing skirt that reaches mid-calf length. The individual is also wearing high-heeled sandals and has accessorized with a delicate necklace and multiple bracelets on one wrist. Their hair is styled in a short, layered cut. The person behind them is dressed in a black outfit consisting of a short-sleeved shirt and dark pants.
